select FIN_CASH_INFO.Cash_Id cashId, FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID feeId, FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE effDate, FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.BASE_RULE floatBaseRule, FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.AST_VDATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, NVL(FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.BASE_TYPE,MST_FEEINFO.BASIC_BILL) basicBill, MST_FEEINFO.BASIS basis, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.ACCR_TYPE accrType, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.INTERVAL_RULE interValRule, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.F_ACCR_END_DATE fAccrEndDate, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.ACCR_TDAY_RULE accrTdayRule, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FIN_CASH_INFO.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate, FIN_CASH_INFO.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, FIN_CASH_INFO.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, FIN_CASH_INFO.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, FIN_CASH_INFO.prod_style prodStyle, FIN_CASH_INFO.TERM_MAX investmentCycle, FIN_PRODUCT.vdate, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodid, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_TYPE rateType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE*100 rate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.COEFFICIENT coefficient, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.INDEX_ID indexId, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.INDEX_SOURCE indexSource, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RESET_TYPE resetType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.REMARK remark from (SELECT FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID, FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID, FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.FIRST_PAY_DATE, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.END_TDAY_RULE, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_TDAY_RULE, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_CYCLE, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.TERM_MAX FROM FIN_CASH_INFO JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE ON FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID WHERE FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2} AND (FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} OR PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}) AND FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}) FIN_CASH_INFO , FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE, MST_FEEINFO, FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO ON FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE = #{baseRuleType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.PUBLISH_TYPE = #{publishType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
where FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BRANCH = 0
and FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and (FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE AND FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2= #{finprodType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

bpp.cdate = ( SELECT MAX(cdate) FROM bok_position_prd WHERE FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} AND cdate <= #{queryDate} AND BRANCH = 0) and bpp.finprod_id= #{finprodId}
